params._admin: Address granted `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` and `PAUSER_ROLE` (typically the governance Safe).
params._saleEnd: Deposit window closing timestamp (exclusive); must be after `_saleStart`.
params._saleStart: Deposit window opening timestamp; must be in the future.

params.amount: `usdc` amount to deposit; the caller must have approved it beforehand.

finalize().details: Deliberately permissionless, free of external calls, and not gated by pause: no actor, including a      compromised admin or pauser, can prevent finalization once the sale has ended.

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

recoverAfterDeadline(address,address,uin.details: `claimDeadline` is zero until finalization, so recovery is impossible while the funding gate protects      deposits and for the full claim window afterwards.

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

params.newEnd: New closing timestamp; must be after `newStart`.
params.newStart: New opening timestamp; must be in the future.

CLAIM_WINDOW().notice: Length of the claim window after finalization. After it closes, claims revert and the admin can         recover unclaimed allocations, unclaimed refunds, and rounding dust.

allocationOf(address).notice: `saleToken` allocation of `account`: `deposit * saleAllocation / max(totalDeposits, hardCap)`.         A live estimate while deposits are open; exact once the sale ends. Floor-rounded, so the sum of all         allocations never exceeds `saleAllocation`.

claimDeadline().notice: Timestamp at which claims close, set once by `finalize` to `block.timestamp + CLAIM_WINDOW`.         Zero until finalization, which also blocks `recoverAfterDeadline` until the sale is finalized.

claimRefund().notice: Claims the caller's `usdc` refund (oversubscribed sales only). One-shot, available from finalization         until `claimDeadline`. Refunds go to the depositing wallet itself.

claimTokens().notice: Claims the caller's full `saleToken` allocation. One-shot, available from finalization until         `claimDeadline`. 100% unlock, no vesting.

deposit(uint256).notice: Deposits `usdc` into the sale. Callable any number of times per account during `[saleStart, saleEnd)`         with no individual limit. Requires the contract to already hold the full `saleAllocation` of         `saleToken` so that claims are guaranteed deliverable.

deposits(address).notice: `usdc` deposited per account. Never reset; both claim legs derive from it.

finalize().notice: Finalizes the sale after `saleEnd`, freezing allocations and opening claims until `claimDeadline`.

finalized().notice: Whether `finalize` has run. Freezes allocations and refunds and opens claims.

funded().notice: Whether the contract holds the full `saleAllocation` of `saleToken` (deposits require it).

hardCap().notice: Maximum `usdc` retained by the sale (100,000e6 = $100k). Implied price = `hardCap / saleAllocation`.

pause().notice: Pauses deposits and both claim legs. Only callable by `PAUSER_ROLE`. `finalize` and admin fund         management are never pausable.

proceedsWithdrawn().notice: Whether the admin has withdrawn the sale proceeds.

recoverAfterDeadline(address,address,uin.notice: After `claimDeadline`, recovers any token still held by the contract (never-claimed allocations and         refunds, rounding dust, accidental sends). Only callable by `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE`.

refundClaimed(address).notice: Whether an account has claimed its `usdc` refund.

refundOf(address).notice: `usdc` refund of `account`: `deposit * (totalDeposits - hardCap) / totalDeposits` when the sale is         oversubscribed, zero otherwise. A live estimate while deposits are open; exact once the sale ends.         Floor-rounded, so the sum of all refunds never exceeds `totalDeposits - hardCap` and every refund         remains payable after the admin withdraws `hardCap` of proceeds.

saleAllocation().notice: Total `saleToken` amount distributed by the sale (10,000,000e18 K613).

saleEnd().notice: Deposit window closing timestamp (exclusive). Reschedulable by the admin only before `saleStart`.

saleInfo().notice: Aggregate sale parameters and statistics for the sale page in a single call.

saleStart().notice: Deposit window opening timestamp. Reschedulable by the admin only before the window opens.

saleToken().notice: Token sold to participants (K613). Must be transferred to this contract before deposits open.

setSaleWindow(uint256,uint256).notice: Reschedules the sale window. Only callable by `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` and only strictly before the         current `saleStart`; once the sale has started the window is immutable.

stage().notice: Current lifecycle stage, derived from time and finalization state.

sweepUnsoldTokens(address).notice: Sweeps `saleToken` held above the outstanding claim liability (`totalTokensSold - totalTokensClaimed`).         Covers unsold tokens in an undersubscribed sale and any over-funding. Only callable by         `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE`, after finalization; repeatable, since the reserve shrinks as users claim.

tokensClaimed(address).notice: Whether an account has claimed its `saleToken` allocation.

totalDeposits().notice: Sum of all `usdc` deposits credited so far.

totalRefundsClaimed().notice: Total `usdc` paid out via `claimRefund`. Stored for off-chain observability.

totalTokensClaimed().notice: Total `saleToken` paid out via `claimTokens`. Feeds the sweep reserve so unclaimed allocations stay covered.

totalTokensSold().notice: Total `saleToken` sold, set once by `finalize`: full `saleAllocation` when `totalDeposits >= hardCap`,         otherwise `totalDeposits * saleAllocation / hardCap`.

unpause().notice: Resumes deposits and claims. Only callable by `PAUSER_ROLE`.

usdc().notice: Payment token deposited by participants (USDC on Monad). Assumed fee-less standard ERC20.

userInfo(address).notice: Full position of `account` for the user dashboard in a single call.

withdrawProceeds(address).notice: Withdraws the sale proceeds, `min(totalDeposits, hardCap)` of `usdc`, leaving the refund pool intact.         Only callable by `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE`, after finalization, once.
